note.alt: An amber-lit room enclosed by glass and structural beams, with a desk, monitors and shelves.
note.description: Glass and metal frame a room filled with warm light. Desks, screens and shelves turn the enclosed space into a small inhabited world, with tiny movements revealing themselves as the scene unfolds.

note.alt: A blue and violet city intersection with illuminated shop signs beneath a golden sky.
note.description: Deep blue streets meet a golden sky in a city assembled from signs, stairs and stacked buildings. The wide view gives the architecture room to breathe while scattered lights keep the scene quietly alive.

note.alt: A dim room crowded with old televisions, computer screens, a sofa and tangled everyday objects.
note.description: A collection of screens glows inside a dim, cluttered room. Cables, shelves and familiar objects surround their cool light, holding the interior in the restless stillness of another sleepless night.

note.alt: A quiet sloping street with a glowing corner shop, trees and apartment buildings in the dusk.
note.description: A corner shop warms a quiet street beneath trees and apartment blocks. The road curves away into the distance, letting the lights of the neighbourhood draw a gentle path through the evening.

note.alt: A city street with red lanterns, a large tree and layered buildings beneath a pink evening sky.
note.description: A rose-coloured sky settles over lanterns, shop windows and a broad tree. Warm and cool lights gather along the street, giving this dense urban corner the softness of a passing evening.

note.alt: A dark interior with red furniture, small screens and a tall window looking onto falling rain.
note.description: Rain fills a tall window beyond the red and blue glow of a small interior. The room feels sheltered and close, while the moving weather outside makes its quiet details feel warmer.

note.alt: A railway platform with overhead structures, a vending machine and a pastel sky beyond the tracks.
note.description: A railway platform opens towards tracks and a pale evening sky. Overhead beams and nearby buildings frame the view, leaving a quiet space that seems ready for a familiar journey home.

note.alt: A snowy city corner with glowing signs, red lanterns and a violet sky above tightly packed buildings.
note.description: Snow gathers beneath illuminated signs and red lanterns. A distant glow softens the violet sky, turning a cold street corner into a place that feels both remote and quietly welcoming.

note.alt: A teal city passage overlooking a huge orange sun, distant towers and hanging shop signs.
note.description: A huge orange sun appears between dark teal buildings. Signs, railings and overhead structures frame the distant skyline, making an ordinary passage feel like a lookout over another world.

note.alt: A shadowy control room filled with monitors, consoles, overhead cables and a red-lit doorway.
note.description: Monitors and control panels break up the shadows of a tightly packed room. Cool screens and a red-lit doorway offer competing points of light, inviting a slow look into its darker corners.

note.alt: A blue-lit urban courtyard with hanging cables, a glass roof and illuminated shops beyond a wet floor.
note.description: Cool light filters through a roof of glass and cables into an enclosed urban space. Shopfronts and reflections scatter small fragments of colour across the wet ground below.

note.alt: A warm amber room with a small computer, shelves, plants, overhead pipes and a room beyond.
note.description: Amber light gathers around a small computer and shelves of everyday objects. Plants, pipes and an open doorway give the room depth, while its steady glow turns a busy interior into a place to linger.
